source_title: FELINA, breaking-bad-305-mas-2010, breaking-bad-306-sunset-2010, breaking-bad-311-abiquiu-2010, e13s3, e1s3, e3s1, pilot

core_style.default_register: formal - often uses precise language and technical terms
core_style.sentence_shape: compound runs - frequently elaborates on points with detailed explanations
core_style.rhythm: slow-deliberate - takes time to articulate thoughts clearly
core_style.two_registers: switches to a more casual tone when interacting with family, but maintains formality in business contexts

humor.style: dark - often uses humor to deflect serious situations
humor.frequency: occasional - humor appears when tension is high or to assert dominance
humor.mechanism: setup-then-subvert - often presents a serious statement before twisting it with irony

structural_patterns: builds a list and corrupts the last entry
speech_signature.naming_behavior: uses formal titles and full names, indicating a desire for control and respect
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes shorter and more direct, often using blunt statements when vulnerable

vocabulary_fingerprint.domain_jargon: chemistry - frequently references chemical processes and terminology
vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: uses ellipses to indicate hesitation or contemplation

worldview.the ends justify the means: demonstrated by his willingness to manipulate others and engage in illegal activities for the sake of his family
worldview.family is paramount: consistently expresses the need to provide for and protect his family, even at great personal cost

self_image_vs_reality.reality: his actions are driven by a desire for power and recognition, often at the expense of his family
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: becomes defensive and aggressive when confronted about his true motivations

emotional_tells.when_guarded: speaks in a controlled, formal manner, avoiding emotional language
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech quickens, with shorter sentences and a more urgent tone
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to blunt statements, often lacking elaboration
emotional_tells.when_in_control: uses authoritative language, often making demands or issuing commands

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: initially stalls or attempts to negotiate, but may resort to aggression if necessary
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back with logical arguments, often using technical jargon to assert his position
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes intensely focused and protective, often resorting to threats to ensure safety
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: rarely admits fault, often redirects the conversation or doubles down on his stance

escalation_pattern: begins with negotiation, escalates to threats if not taken seriously, and ultimately resorts to violence if necessary

relationship_matrix.Elliott: seeks to manipulate for financial gain while maintaining a facade of civility
relationship_matrix.Skyler: struggles to maintain control and respect, often leading to conflict

social_positioning.desired_position: wants to be seen as a powerful figure in control of his destiny
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: others often see him as a desperate man who has lost control of his life
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between his desire for respect and the reality of his actions costs him his family and integrity
